Name: The Shipwrecked Farm REMIXED
Author: TheFallSeason
Description:
[b][color=#b6d7a8]You just inherited your grandpa's farm, which is... an archipelago?! a small farm that consists of 8 islands with unique features![/color]
[/b][color=#d9ead3]Dare to try this farm? Do you love fishing? Grandpa has left you some amazing supplies and a letter explaining why this farm is special!
[/color]
[b][color=#b6d7a8]Special features:
[/color][list]
[*][color=#d9ead3]The starting gift gives you 2 crab pots, 44 normal baits, a fiberglass rod, a fishing book, and a fish smoker! but no seeds![/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Small quarry/sprinklable 5x5 area in the left bottom island[/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Blue grass spawns around the archipelago[/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Cave/greenhouse/quarry grassy area shortcut locked behind pickaxe/axe 1st and 2nd upgrades[/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Easy transportation system! The boats will quickly take you to the backwoods, the bus stop, or the forest![/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Beach forage will spawn regularly in this farm![/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Palm trees on the farm! (They can drop seeds that grow new palm trees; however, chopping down a palm tree completely won't give you any palm tree seeds; be warned!)[/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Variety of fish schools during each season![/color]
[*][color=#d9ead3]Special catches during summer/winter![/color]
[/list]
[color=#ffe599]This is the alternative version of the Shipwrecked farm! https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29406

[/color][color=#a4c2f4]


[/color][/b]
